lead: Maryam Nawaz is best known as a Pakistani politician, born on 28 October 1973 in Lahore.
As of 2026, she is 52 years old, and her birth date places her under the Scorpio sign.
She has held the office of Chief Minister of Punjab.
The sections that follow break down Maryam Nawaz's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.

sections.heading: Maryam Nawaz — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Maryam Nawaz was born on 28 October 1973 in Lahore, and holds Pakistani nationality.
Public records name her father, Nawaz Sharif and her mother, Kulsoom Nawaz. She is a sibling of Hussain Nawaz and Hassan Nawaz.
She studied at University of the Punjab.
She is recorded as speaking Urdu.

sections.heading: Maryam Nawaz — Career and Professional Work
paras: Maryam Nawaz works primarily as a politician.
She has held the following offices: Chief Minister of Punjab (2024–present). She is affiliated with Pakistan Muslim League (N).

sections.heading: Maryam Nawaz — Family, Marriage and Personal Life
paras: She is married to Safdar Awan (married 1992).
She is a parent to Mahnoor Safdar and Mehr-un-Nisa Munir.
